tei:div.tei:p:
O Sovereign of the Universe! before all things I have no
mouth to reply, nor forehead to lift up my head, because my iniquities are too numerous to be counted, and my sins too great to be told, and their burden is too heavy for me. I now confess before thee, O Lord my God, with bowed down head, with bent attitude, with diminished strength, with enfeebled power, with a broken heart, with humble spirit, with prostration and genuflexion, with dread and terror, with tremor and trembling, with fear and awe, I declare before thee, O Lord my God, a small portion of my wicked deeds, and crooked ways, and contemptible works; to tell them wholly is impossible, to set them forth clearly I have not the power, to reveal them I lack strength; I know not how to utter them, I am unable to shew them, and what am I, and what is my life that I should ask pardon and forgiveness for them? Alas! I am vanity and emptiness, a worm and an insect, dust and ashes; I am ashamed because of my sins, and confounded because of my transgressions; I have no excuse to plead before thee, mine iniquity is greater than I can bear, my transgressions are too numerous to be told, I am ashamed and confounded, even as a thief who is found breaking up.
